title: Zoho Creator App Prep – Presenter Slides

slides.title: Title
slides.notes: Welcome viewers and introduce the topic. Goal: Know what to plan before creating an app in Zoho Creator.

slides.title: Agenda
slides.notes: Briefly explain what will be covered so viewers know the flow.

slides.title: Define the Purpose
slides.notes: Example: Manage student data and track performance. If you can't summarize your app in one sentence, you're not ready to build.

slides.title: List Key Entities (Forms)
bullets: For each form: fields, required vs optional, relationships
slides.notes: Examples: Student, Teacher, Subject, Marks, Attendance.

slides.title: Map Relationships
slides.notes: One Student → Many Marks; One Teacher → Many Subjects. Relationships eliminate duplication.

slides.title: Plan Reports
bullets: Start with the end in mind
Example: Marks by Subject, Attendance Summary, Top 5 Students
slides.notes: Knowing reports up front shapes form design.

slides.title: Roles & Permissions
slides.notes: Example: Teachers can add marks; Students view only their own.

slides.title: Workflows & Automation
bullets: Examples: calculate averages, send absence SMS
slides.notes: Workflows save time and make your app intelligent.

slides.title: Clear Naming
slides.notes: Clear naming saves hours later when writing Deluge scripts.

slides.title: Test with Sample Data
bullets: Build test version, then clone to prod
slides.notes: Test before launch to catch issues early.

slides.title: How It All Connects
slides.notes: Flow: Form → Workflow → Report → Page. Keep first app simple; iterate.

slides.title: Quick Summary
slides.notes: Close by emphasizing planning and tease next episode: building forms and connecting reports/dashboards.
